Stage D4 section 1, read before any cut (_views/tree-likeness.json; out/_analysis/d4a01_key_freq.py, its output d4a01_key_freq.txt). The statistic: the delta score on the combined level-3 matrix is 0.4227 (Monte Carlo SE 0.0020, 20,000 nondegenerate quartets, seed 0), over 705 rooms and 26,487 lines (the current ledger's accepted specification, elaboration and correction lines; limits excluded). The weights (4, 2, 1, 0.5) and grades (1, 0.5, 0, -1) are prior.md section 7's. The frequencies: at level 3, 5,237 keys; 2,772 are held by one room, 1,509 by 2 to 4, 720 by 5 to 19, 208 by 20 to 99, 28 by 100 or more. Every room holds a key, and no room returned none, so the unadapted group is empty. By kind at level 3: corrections 17 keys in 18 rooms, none held by more than 2 rooms (restrict:R01:T3-033 2); at level 4 restrict:R01:T4-006 and restrict:P05:T4-006 2 each; only at the bare target do corrections reach 5 rooms (restrict:P05 7, restrict:R01 5). Elaborations: 545 keys in 497 rooms; 35 held by 5 to 19 rooms and 2 by 20 or more (add-step:K01:T3-001 22, add-step:K01:T3-023 20); 208 rooms hold none. Specifications: 4,931 keys in 705 rooms; the commonest are instantiate keys (instantiate:P11:T3-009 372, instantiate:P08:T3-010 337, instantiate:P05:T3-005 277). Level-3 keys held by 5 rooms or more, by element: elaborations K01 11, P01 7, P05 7, P04 3, P02 2, P03 2, and one each on K05, K06, P08, P13, P24; specifications on 66 elements, most on P05 36, P16 31, P24 31. Reading: the strongest form signal, shared corrections, is nearly empty in the current ledger, because the D3 revisions absorbed the first-return corrections; the cuts must rest mostly on elaborations and specifications, and the kind of add-condition, add-step and restrict lines is not relied on (J, after the D3c interview).

Amendments after the D3 freeze (J after the D3c interview), decided before writing; tool out/_analysis/d4_amend.py (refuses unless the model starts at the D3 freeze or every later history line is one of its amendments; marks every history line rechecked false with the frozen version), specs written by d4a01_amend_specs.py from history line 172 and d4a01_a11_classes.json. Reasons: the bound keeps the words the 705 rooms were re-checked against and narrows where they hold, while the widened revision adds a route and a holder no room was served and no re-check can now test; the six rooms' alignment warrants a branch, not a universal clause (rule 12), and D4 can still read trunk and branch apart; the three informed-member rooms meet at three nodes, below the trigger, and writing them in would widen the claim without a shared warrant. Move: contrasting. A11: withdrawn (status withdrawn, in_model false, withdrawn_why, amendment), move dropping working hypotheses. Reasons: the order never beat its null (0.600, p95 0.670); in threads template first (98 rooms) is nearly as common as the transition (111) of 228 rooms with both ends; the failure clause stands alone in 117 rooms (talk only 31, layout only 86); 261 accepted restrict lines say a template does not settle the design for good; a reworded arrow would be a new, unserved co-occurrence claim; P02 and P04 hold what remains. asked QD4-001: The D4 close-check refuses the two amendments you asked for. I made them at D4a-01 as recorded amendments under rule 11 (P05: scope sentence in the statement, status bounded, a bound naming the six shape-read rooms and armok, maryland and oneshot with their nine lines; move 198, history lines 173 to 176. A11: withdrawn, in_model false; move 199, history 177 to 180). Each history line carries rechecked false and the frozen version, each element keeps its frozen text in an amendment field, and F-024 and F-017 were re-examined (findings lines 39 and 40). validate.py D4 (out/_analysis/d4a01_validate_D4_01.txt) gives: 'model/ and its tiers moved after D3 froze them (46384686d617..., now 1dc9bc8040a7...); at D4 nothing below the model moves except as a recorded amendment (rule 11)'. tools/checks/stage_D4.py line 218 calls vlib.model_moved(outdir, 'D3', 'D4') with no allowed callable, so no D4 amendment can pass, and the check runs at every D4 leg's close. How shall it go: (a) the harness owner adds an allowance that accepts a model move when every history line after the freeze is stage D4 with rechecked false and a frozen_version equal to out/_closes/model-D3.sha256 (my lines meet this); (b) I revert the two amendments by appending history lines and restoring the frozen records, and carry them as held proposals; or (c) another route you name? | meanwhile: I do not work around the check: no --force, no edit of the check, no revert. The amendments stay as written. I go on with D4a-01's work on the frozen ledger (the distances do not read element text or status, so they are unchanged), and I close with done.sh D4. If the close-check refuses only on model:moved, the leg stays unclosed until your answer.

Sensitivity check (J after the D3c interview), its rule written before it runs: out/_analysis/d4a01_kind_collapsed.py computes distance.py's distance once more on the same shared lines and prior.md's weights and grades, with every add-condition, add-step and restrict line given one kind, 'collapsed', in place of its adjudicated kind (so two different ops among the three grade 0.5, and any of them against another kind's op 0). It compares the result with _views/distance.tsv: Pearson and Spearman over room pairs, the mean absolute difference, the delta score under seed 0, and the ARI between the two average-linkage trees at 2, 3, 5, 8 and 12 clusters. Nothing in _views/ is touched. No cut rests on the adjudicated kind of those three ops; their keys are read in the all-kinds matrices.

Sensitivity check read (out/_analysis/d4a01_kind_collapsed/, .txt). With kind collapsed for add-condition, add-step and restrict (5,638 of the 26,487 shared lines: add-condition 178 elaboration and 1,045 specification; add-step 428, 991 and 2 corrections; restrict 26, 2,952 and 16 corrections), the combined distance moves little: Pearson 0.9965 and Spearman 0.9967 over 248,160 room pairs, 153,437 pairs changed, mean absolute difference 0.0024; the delta score 0.4223 against the carried 0.4227. The average-linkage trees agree at 2 and 3 clusters (ARI 1.00), and less at finer cuts: 0.886 at 5, 0.922 at 8, 0.779 at 12. Reading: the combined distance and its coarse groups do not rest on the adjudicated kind of those ops; the per-kind views do, since for add-step and add-condition the specification lines outnumber the elaboration lines about 2 to 1 and 6 to 1. So no cut reads a branch's membership from the per-kind matrices for those ops; keys are read in the all-kinds matrices, and a branch's kind field is reported as the kind of its members' lines, not relied on.
